subject: Post-demo: procurement contacts, required evidence, and pilot discount request
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@carelytic.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carelytic.com>, David Campbell <david.campbell@carelytic.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders

Hannah — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and where we landed on our side: 

- Audience: CFO (Monica Reyes) is the economic buyer; procurement (procurement@carelytic.com) runs the contracting cadence; David Campbell (CISO) will own the security questionnaire and required evidence.
- Pilot scope: 3-month pilot, ~300k tokens/month, evaluate latency and cost per inference for clinical summarization workflows.
- Must-haves: SOC 2 evidence (summary), contract with standard indemnities, and a pilot price that the CFO can approve.

Procurement asked for an estimated price and if you can offer a one-time pilot discount to get internal sign-off. Also attached a rough internal timeline: procurement decision targeted by 10/08.

Next steps from Carelytic: I can introduce you to Monica and the procurement lead if that helps. From your side, can you send a brief mutual action plan (MAP), an expected cost estimate for the pilot, and a list of security artifacts (SOC2, data handling summary)?

Thanks —
Alex
Alexandra Chen
Director of Clinical Products | Carelytic Inc.
(415) 555-0142

[Attachment: Carelytic_internal_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@carelytic.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders

Hi Alex — great meeting; appreciate the clear stakeholder map. Attaching a short MAP and initial pilot estimate. High level:

- MAP: milestones (intro to Monica -> procurement PO -> security review -> start pilot), owners, and acceptance criteria. (attached: Carelytic_MAP_v1.xlsx)
- Pricing: estimated pilot run-rate $3,200/month (post-discount math below) for the scope you described; final price depends on committed monthly token minimum and SLA terms.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 summary, encryption notes, and our contact for a short security call. (SOC2-OnePager.pdf attached)

About the discount: we can consider a pilot discount but will need internal approval on the percent and duration. If you can confirm procurement's preferred contracting cadence (PO vs. SOW), that will help move approvals faster.

I'll loop in Legal and Security internally with a succinct ask: conditional approval for a 25% pilot discount if Carelytic signs a committed PO for the 3-month pilot and we get SOC2 evidence by contract signature.

Proposed next step: I can do a three-way intro between you, Monica (CFO), and Ben (AE) to run the economic conversation early next week.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Carelytic_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-OnePager.pdf]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@carelytic.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carelytic.com>, Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@carelytic.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders

Thanks Hannah — that looks helpful. Procurement prefers a PO (not SOW) for pilots. Monica asked if Redwood can commit to a 25% pilot discount for the first three months and guarantee a dedicated onboarding resource from your CS team. Also, David (CISO) is available for a security call next Thursday (9/30) at 11am PT to review SOC2 and data handling specifics.

Let me know if you can confirm the discount and the SLA baseline (they want to see 99.95% for availability in the contract).

-Alex

[Procurement note: timeline updated — decision goal 10/06]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders — approval request (pilot discount & SLA exception)

Team — forwarding Carelytic's ask. Quick summary and the approvals I need to close the loop: 

- External ask: 25% pilot discount (3 months) + CS onboarding resource + contract SLA target 99.95%. Carelytic will sign via PO.
- Preconditions: SOC2 summary delivered to security; procurement requires PO; CFO wants commitment on pilot price.

Specific internal approvals: 
1) Pricing: Ben — can you authorize 25% off for a time-boxed pilot given RWI-2026-0867 context?
2) Security: Dev — can you confirm whether we can accept SOC2-OnePager + a 1-hour call as sufficient for a pilot, or we need additional artifact(s)?
3) Legal: Laura — if we need to concede SLA to 99.95%, what contract redlines should we push back on (and can we accept a limited SLA exception for a 3-month pilot)?

I've attached the draft SLA redlines from Carelytic (Draft_SLA_Redlines.docx). Goal: respond to Alex by 9/24 EOD so they can progress procurement.

Thanks —
Hannah

[Attachment: Draft_SLA_Redlines.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders — approval request (pilot discount & SLA exception)

Hannah — I'm okay to authorize a 25% time-limited pilot discount under the following conditions: 

- Commitment: Carelytic signs a 3-month PO with a minimum monthly token commitment as proposed in the MAP.
- Visibility: Monthly usage reports shared with sales and CS; automatic re-eval if actuals exceed estimate by >30%.
- Margin: No additional discounts applied in parallel (product/engineering credits excluded).

If Legal or Security push back on SLA or evidence, we should hold discount approval until they clear it. Marissa — please confirm you can allocate a named onboarding lead for the pilot.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders — approval request (pilot discount & SLA exception)

Hannah/Ben — looked at the SOC2-OnePager. For a pilot with limited data scope we can accept: 

- SOC2 summary + 1-hr security call covering data flows, encryption at-rest/in-transit, and retention.
- Must capture a scoped data processing addendum (DPA) specifying that no PHI will be retained beyond pilot windows and that KV caches are disabled for the pilot workload.
- SLA: we cannot guarantee 99.95% on hosted shared capacity for a new pilot without dedicated capacity. We can offer a 99.9% availability commitment for the pilot (with clear escalation and remediation SLAs). If the customer can accept 99.9% for 3 months we can proceed; alternatively, they can contract Dedicated capacity (higher cost) to attain 99.95%.

If that trade-off is acceptable, Security signs off on the pilot with the DPA and the SOC2 summary uploaded to their procurement portal.

-Dev
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders — approval request (pilot discount & SLA exception)

Team — Legal can accept a temporary SLA exception to 99.9% for a time-boxed 3-month pilot with the following guardrails: 

1) Exception language explicitly limited to the pilot term in the SOW/PO.
2) No change to indemnity or data-privacy obligations.
3) If there's a material uptime incident impacting acceptance criteria, Carelytic gets a service credit defined in the pilot SOW (capped).
4) Procurement must sign the PO with explicit acknowledgement of the pilot SLA.

If Security confirms the DPA and SOC2 artifacts, Legal approves moving forward with the 25% pilot discount (per Ben's conditional approval). I'll prepare a short addendum and the clause to limit SLA scope to the pilot.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@carelytic.com>
Cc: Monica Reyes <monica.reyes@carelytic.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@carelytic.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo summary + internal stakeholders

Alex — thanks for the clarity and for lining up the security call. Quick update and consolidated next steps from Redwood: 

- Discount & pricing: We can offer a 25% time-limited pilot discount (3 months) conditional on Carelytic signing a 3-month PO with the committed monthly token minimum in the attached MAP.
- SLA: For the pilot we will contractually accept 99.9% availability (pilot-only exception). If Carelytic requires 99.95% we can provision Dedicated capacity at a higher rate; I'll include that pricing in the MAP addendum.
- Security evidence: Please upload SOC2 summary to the shared Drive folder and confirm the 9/30 11am PT security call with Dev (redwood security). We will require a scoped DPA for the pilot stating no PHI is stored and cache settings disabled.
- CS: Marissa will be your named onboarding lead. She will prepare a kickoff plan and success criteria aligned to the MAP.

If these conditions look acceptable, please have procurement issue the PO and we'll countersign the pilot addendum. I'll follow up after your 9/30 security call to finalize the redlines.

Best regards,
Hannah
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Carelytic_MAP_v1.xlsx, Draft_SLA_Redlines.docx]
